question: A right triangle with sides 60 cm, 45 cm and 75 cm is rotated about the side of 60 cm to form a cone. The curved surface area (in cm²) of the cone so formed is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When a **right triangle** is rotated about its **altitude** (side), that side becomes the **height (h)** and the other side becomes the **radius (r)**.

Given sides: 60 cm (axis), 45 cm (base), 75 cm (hypotenuse).

⇒ **Radius (r)** = 45 cm, **Slant height (l)** = 75 cm.

⇒ **Curved Surface Area** = πrl = π × 45 × 75 = 3375π cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 3375π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sides of the **right triangle** are 60 cm, 45 cm, and 75 cm.

Rotation axis = 60 cm side.

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a **cone** = πrl

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bfcd219ab75a9e2f5e322e52aab33003a623f0b874c68d82f86e6f8579e1dda2.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ When rotated about the 60 cm side, the **height (h)** of the cone = 60 cm.

⇒ The **base radius (r)** of the cone = 45 cm.

⇒ The **slant height (l)** of the cone corresponds to the hypotenuse = 75 cm.

⇒ CSA = π × r × l

⇒ CSA = π × 45 × 75

⇒ CSA = 3375π cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 3375π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cone Formation by Rotation

Rotating a right triangle about its **perpendicular** or **base** generates a cone where the axis of rotation is the height.

Slant Height Relation

The relationship between radius, height, and slant height is given by l² = r² + h².

Total Surface Area of Cone

TSA = πrl + πr² = πr(l + r). It includes the **curved surface** and the **circular base**.</p
